# `make_timestamp_ltz`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
make_timestamp_ltz(year, month, day, hour, min, sec[, timezone])
```

Create the current timestamp with local time zone from year, month, day, hour, min, sec and (optional) timezone fields. If the configuration `spark.sql.ansi.enabled` is false, the function returns NULL on invalid inputs. Otherwise, it will throw an error instead.

make_timestamp_ltz(date, time[, timezone]) - Create a local date-time from date, time and (optional) timezone fields.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `datetime_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.4.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | [2, 6] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT make_timestamp_ltz(2014, 12, 28, 6, 30, 45.887);
```

Result:

```text
2014-12-28 06:30:45.887
```

```sql
SELECT make_timestamp_ltz(2014, 12, 28, 6, 30, 45.887, 'CET');
```

Result:

```text
2014-12-27 21:30:45.887
```

```sql
SELECT make_timestamp_ltz(2019, 6, 30, 23, 59, 60);
```

Result:

```text
2019-07-01 00:00:00
```

```sql
SELECT make_timestamp_ltz(null, 7, 22, 15, 30, 0);
```

Result:

```text
NULL
```

```sql
SELECT make_timestamp_ltz(DATE'2014-12-28', TIME'6:30:45.887');
```

Result:

```text
2014-12-28 06:30:45.887
```

```sql
SELECT make_timestamp_ltz(DATE'2014-12-28', TIME'6:30:45.887', 'CET');
```

Result:

```text
2014-12-27 21:30:45.887
```
